excerpt.zh: 游客欣赏着[root.solar_system.GetName]恒星系的美景，惊叹于身边的种种奇景。当踏上归途时，他们将再也不同往日了，因为对宇宙之广阔的一手认知将会重塑他们。
excerpt.en: The tourists enjoyed the sights in the [root.solar_system.GetName] system, marveling at the wonders around them. They will return home changed, carrying with them first-hand knowledge of the vastness of the universe.

triggers.en: When a fleet enters a system

tooltips.zh: 可以在情报日志追踪目标恒星系。
tooltips.en: The target system can be tracked in the Situation Log.
